sky cinema action.title: 300: Rise of an Empire

sky cinema action.title: Supergirl

sky cinema action.title: The Running Man

sky cinema action.title: The Fix
sky cinema action.desc: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operators set out for Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

sky cinema action.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
sky cinema action.desc: Three years after the destruction of the Jurassic World theme park, Owen Grady and Claire Dearing return to the island of Isla Nublar to save the remaining dinosaurs from a volcano that's about to erupt. They soon encounter terrifying new breeds of gigantic dinosaurs, while uncovering a conspiracy that threatens the entire planet.

sky cinema action.title: Supergirl

sky cinema action.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II

sky cinema action.title: Batman Returns
sky cinema action.desc: After Selina Kyle sees more than she should in her boss's office, she has an `accident', falling from the top floor of the building to the street below. Awoken by the licking of cats, she is surprised to find herself still very much alive. She vows to take revenge on her boss and becomes a female avenger, defending women under attack and providing assistance to Batman's efforts to keep the streets of Gotham safe.

sky cinema action.title: First Knight
sky cinema action.desc: Dissatisfied with King Arthur's rule of peace and freedom, Malagant, an erstwhile ally, turns against the Round Table and establishes a hostile domain. However, he goes too far when he kidnaps the queen and imprisons her in an appalling dungeon. The special skills of the glittering and impetuous swordsman Lancelot must be called upon to effect her rescue.

sky cinema family.title: Shark Tale
sky cinema family.desc: A fast-talking fish gains fame after taking credit for the accidental death of a shark mobster. While enjoying the popularity at first, his tall tale starts to unravel as others begin to suspect that he is not the Defender of the Reef after all, and when the shark's enemies get involved, his lies lead him into dangerous waters. A DreamWorks animation.

sky cinema family.title: Hotel Transylvania
sky cinema family.desc: Dracula, who operates a high-end resort away from the human world, goes into overprotective mode when a boy discovers the resort and falls for the count's teen-aged daughter.

sky cinema family.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
sky cinema family.desc: Concerned that his half-human grandson isn't showing his vampire side, Dracula and his friends put the boy through a `monster-in-training' boot camp just as Drac's old-school father decides to pay a visit.

sky cinema family.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
sky cinema family.desc: Mavis surprises Dracula with plans for a fun-filled summer voyage on a monster cruise. As the pack starts enjoying colossal buffets and exotic excursions, Drac finds himself falling for the ship's intriguing but dangerous captain. He soon learns that trying to balance family, friends and romance might just be too much to handle. even for the world's most powerful vampire.

sky cinema family.title: GOAT
sky cinema family.desc: A small goat named Will gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball -- a high-intensity, full-contact sport that's dominated by the fastest, fiercest animals in the world.

sky cinema family.title: Johnny English
sky cinema family.desc: Spoof spy caper with the eponymous, blundering hero attempting to recover the crown jewels and save Britain from an evil mastermind when all the other agents are killed. Promoted from lowly pen pusher to super spy, Johnny English is baffled when clues lead to respected entrepreneur Pascal Sauvage, but could the enigmatic Lorna hold the key to the mystery?

sky cinema family.title: Johnny English Reborn
sky cinema family.desc: A haphazard spy returns to MI-7 after years in a Tibetan monastery honing his zen skills. Armed with gizmos, gadgets and chaotic luck he takes on a global ring of assassins.

sky cinema family.title: Johnny English Strikes Again
sky cinema family.desc: Johnny English springs back into action when a hacker reveals the identities of undercover agents in Britain. As a man with few skills and analogue methods, Johnny must overcome the challenges of modern technology to make this mission a success.

sky cinema family.title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
sky cinema family.desc: Charlie Bucket comes from a poor family, and spends most of his time dreaming about the chocolate that he loves but usually can't afford. Things change when Willy Wonka, head of the very popular Wonka Chocolate empire, announces a contest in which five gold tickets have been hidden in chocolate bars. Charlie is one of the five kids who finds a lucky ticket and goes on a tour of Wonka's chocolate factory.

sky cinema family.title: How to Train Your Dragon
sky cinema family.desc: A young Viking with aspirations of becoming a dragon hunter befriends a young dragon himself and learns more about the creatures than he ever assumed.

sky cinema family.title: Goosebumps 2
sky cinema family.desc: Best friends Sonny and Sam meet Slappy, a mischievous dummy who brings his ghoulish friends back to life -- just in time for Halloween. As the town becomes overrun with monsters, the boys join forces to save Sonny's mom and foil Slappy's wicked plan.

sky cinema family.title: The BFG
sky cinema family.desc: A 10-year-old girl, Queen Victoria and the Big Friendly Giant must devise a plan to get rid of Bloodbottler, Fleshlumpeater and all the other bad giants once and for all.

sky cinema family.title: Sonic the Hedgehog 3
sky cinema family.desc: Sonic, Knuckles and Tails reunite to battle Shadow, a mysterious new enemy with powers unlike anything they've faced before. With their abilities outmatched in every way, they seek out an unlikely alliance to stop Shadow and protect the planet.

sky cinema comedy.title: My Dead Friend Zoe

sky cinema comedy.title: Zoolander

sky cinema comedy.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective

sky cinema comedy.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
sky cinema comedy.desc: Sequel about the zany private detective who specialises in locating missing pets. Ace Ventura travels to Africa to search for a kidnapped sacred albino bat, which reputedly has the power to restore peace between two warring tribes.

sky cinema comedy.title: Bean: The Ultimate Disaster Movie

The catch is that Bean is no art expert and his trip was a ploy by his British employers to get rid of him. Unfortunately, no one has warned the Americans about Mr Bean.

sky cinema comedy.title: Mr Bean's Holiday
sky cinema comedy.desc: Mr Bean is going on holiday to the south of France, looking for a quiet and sunny trip in the Riviera. However, his trip doesn't go as smoothly as he expected when he has to face a series of misunderstandings and totally unfortunate coincidences. Eventually, Mr Bean will end up spoiling the last film of the snobbish director Carson Clay and appearing by accident at the Cannes Film Festival.

sky cinema comedy.title: Bridesmaids

sky cinema comedy.title: You've Got Mail

sky cinema comedy.title: American Pie: Reunion
